sfpuc_gi_grant_cap_per_impervious_acre.unit: USD per impervious acre managed (grant cap)
sfpuc_gi_grant_cap_per_impervious_acre.metric_unit: USD per m2 impervious area managed
sfpuc_gi_grant_cap_per_impervious_acre.source: SFPUC Green Infrastructure Grant Program - Program Guidelines July 2026
sfpuc_gi_grant_cap_per_impervious_acre.quote: maximum of $1,120,000 per impervious acre managed, up to a maximum of $2,500,000 per Grant Award (raised Feb 2026 from $1,035,000; 2018 original $765,000/acre). Projects must capture the 90th percentile storm (0.75 in).
sfpuc_gi_grant_cap_per_impervious_acre.derived_note: metric = 1,120,000/4046.86 m2; cap reflects SF GI cost per impervious area drained, not per m2 of GI footprint

fasip_tunnel_geometry.source: Folsom Area Stormwater Improvement Project (SFPUC); CEQA NOD 2023050406; tunnelingonline Upcoming Projects April 2025
fasip_tunnel_geometry.quote: Alameda Street Wet Weather Conveyance Tunnel ... approximately 4,000 feet long with a 12-foot inside diameter and three shafts (CEQA: approximately 3,800 linear feet of 12-foot inside-diameter tunnel along Alameda, De Haro, and Berry streets ... to the Channel Transport/Storage Box near 7th and Berry)

discount_rate_fema_bca.source: ASFPM: FEMA Rolls Back BCA Rates for Mitigation Projects; FEMA Policy 206-23-001 (Apr 24 2024)
discount_rate_fema_bca.quote: On April 8 [2025], OMB revoked the November 2023 update to OMB Circular No. A-94 ... which had set the discount rate at 3.1%. OMB reinstated its October 1992 version ... returning the discount rate to 7%. HMA projects not obligated/awarded as of April 8, 2025 must use the 7% discount rate.

dry_floodproofing_usace_nnc.unit: USD per sq ft building footprint (wood frame; brick $22)
dry_floodproofing_usace_nnc.source: USACE - Analysis of Nonstructural Committee Assessment, Lower Meramec Basin Multi-Jurisdictional Floodplain Management Plan, Appendix E (April 2020)
dry_floodproofing_usace_nnc.quote: dry floodproofing is estimated to cost $25 per square foot for wood frame structures and $22 per square foot for brick structures ... An additional $1,600 was added to each floodproofing estimate to account for installation of a sewer check valve. (Upper Joachim Creek report: $23.32/sf wood, $21.17/sf brick incl. veneer wall and watertight doors)

floodwall_usace_naccs_10ft.unit: USD per linear ft, 10 ft high floodwall (first construction cost)
floodwall_usace_naccs_10ft.metric_unit: USD per m length (3.05 m high)
floodwall_usace_naccs_10ft.source: USACE North Atlantic Coast Comprehensive Study (NACCS) Appendix C Parametric Costs, Sec VIII Coastal Storm Risk Management Measures
floodwall_usace_naccs_10ft.quote: For a 10 foot high floodwall construction, first construction costs are about $5,335 per linear foot; annualized costs are about $237 per linear foot.
floodwall_usace_naccs_10ft.derivation: metric: /0.3048 m per ft; per m height /3.048 m (linear-in-height assumption)

floodwall_small_residential.unit: USD per linear ft, 4 ft above grade (2 ft: $90/lf)
floodwall_small_residential.metric_unit: USD per m length (1.22 m high)
floodwall_small_residential.source: Southern Tier Central Regional Planning Board - Selecting Floodproofing Techniques, Financial Considerations
floodwall_small_residential.quote: Floodwalls: 2 feet above ground level - $90 per linear foot; 4 feet above ground level - $132 per linear foot. Sprayed-on cement (above grade) $3.50/sq ft; waterproof membrane $1.17/sq ft.

fasip_phase2_srf_loan.unit: USD, CWSRF loan not-to-exceed for FASIP Phase 2 (tunnel + box sewer etc.); NOT full construction cost
fasip_phase2_srf_loan.quote: Clean Water State Revolving Fund Loan for the Wastewater Enterprise Folsom Area Stormwater Improvement Project Phase 2 in an amount not to exceed $59,000,000, with a principal forgiveness (grant) amount of up to $5,000,000.
fasip_phase2_srf_loan.note: Lower bound proxy only; total tunnel construction cost not found in public sources searched.

permeable_pavement_epa.unit: USD per sq ft (permeable pavement, RSMeans 2019 via EPA)
permeable_pavement_epa.source: EPA Stormwater BMP Fact Sheet: Permeable Pavements (2021); EPA Green Infrastructure Implementation Strategy for the Town of Franklin MA
permeable_pavement_epa.quote: ~$8 per square foot for the permeable alternative (RSMeans 2019). Franklin: Permeable asphalts can range from as low as $3-5 per square foot; porous concrete and pavers can range from $9-15 per square foot.

permeable_pavement_san_diego.unit: USD per sq ft porous concrete (porous asphalt $8.80)
permeable_pavement_san_diego.source: EPA LID Stormwater Control Cost Estimation Analysis (2015), citing San Diego County SCSMC 2008
permeable_pavement_san_diego.quote: porous concrete costs ranging from $2-$6.50 per square foot and interlocking concrete paving blocks $5-$10 per square foot (WERF 2009). San Diego County ... porous asphalt and porous concrete at $8.80 per square foot and $14.14 per square foot (SCSMC, 2008).

bioretention_bioswale_epa.unit: USD per sq ft (bioretention cell; bioswales similar; rain gardens ~half)
bioretention_bioswale_epa.source: EPA Green Infrastructure Implementation Strategy for the Town of Franklin MA (citing Horsley Witten 2012)
bioretention_bioswale_epa.quote: Bioretention cells typically run $20-$30 per square foot (HW, 2012). Rain gardens are almost half of the above cost. Bioswales are similar in cost to bioretention cells.

bioretention_wa_herrera.unit: USD per sq ft capital (location/time adjusted); O&M $0.97/sf/yr
bioretention_wa_herrera.source: WMEAC Benefit-cost analysis of stormwater green infrastructure (from WA Ecology/Herrera 2012)
bioretention_wa_herrera.quote: mean of the reported low and average costs were $17.95/ft^2 and $0.73/ft^2/year for capital and maintenance ... adjusted for location and time $24.02/ft^2 and adjusted maintenance cost $0.97/ft^2.

green_roof_epa.unit: USD per sq ft extensive green roof (range 22.25-42; intensive 61.25-309)
green_roof_epa.source: EPA LID Stormwater Control Cost Estimation Analysis (2015) citing Peck & Kuhn 2001; Illinois EPA GI BMPs (2020)
green_roof_epa.quote: For inaccessible, extensive green roofs, costs range from $22.25 to $42.00 per square foot and for accessible, intensive green roofs, costs range from $61.25 to $309 per square foot. Illinois EPA 2020: expensive to install ($15 to $20 per square foot).

sf_tree_removal_permit_fee.unit: USD application fee, 1-3 street trees (hazard/diseased); construction $1,004; 4-9 $1,337; 10+ $2,009
sf_tree_removal_permit_fee.source: SF Public Works - Remove a Street Tree (FY2026-27 fees)
sf_tree_removal_permit_fee.quote: 1-3 trees (for diseased, hazard or sidewalk damaged related removals) $499; 1-3 (for Construction or development) $1,004; 4-9 trees $1,337; 10 or more trees $2,009. All costs associated with the removal are the responsibility of the applicant.

sf_tree_in_lieu_replacement_fee.unit: USD per tree in-lieu fee for failure to plant replacement street tree
sf_tree_in_lieu_replacement_fee.source: SF Public Works Permit Fee Schedule 2025-2026 (2026-27 schedule ~ $2,646)
sf_tree_in_lieu_replacement_fee.quote: In-lieu fee for failure to plant 1 tree (per tree): $2,590.00 (FY25-26). FY26-27 PDF appears to show $2,646 (scrambled text).
sf_tree_in_lieu_replacement_fee.note: Good proxy for SF replacement planting cost per street tree (24-in box).

sf_unpermitted_tree_removal_penalty.unit: USD per tree (or replacement value if greater)
sf_unpermitted_tree_removal_penalty.source: SF Public Works Code Sec. 811(c) as summarized on SF Public Works removal page
sf_unpermitted_tree_removal_penalty.quote: $10,000 per tree or the tree's replacement value, whichever is greater; repeat within a year $20,000.

fema_bca_useful_life.unit: years (FEMA standard value; acceptable limits in brackets)
fema_bca_useful_life.source: FEMA BCA Reference Guide (June 2009, rev. Nov 2011) Appendix D Project Useful Life Summary; FDS/restoration value from MA FDS BCA guidance 2016
fema_bca_useful_life.quote: Concrete Infrastructure, Flood Walls, Roads, Bridges, Major Drainage System 50 (35-50); Pump Stations ... Structures 50, Equipment 5 (5-30); Elevation Residential Building 30 (30-50); Non-Residential 25 (25-50); Utility Mitigation Minor (backflow valves, downspout disconnect) 5 (5-30); Hurricane Storm Shutters 15 (15-30); Vegetation Management Forest canopy 20 (3-20).

stormwater_pump_station_alexandria.unit: USD per cfs capacity (direct cost); PS2 ~ $62k/cfs
stormwater_pump_station_alexandria.source: City of Alexandria VA, RiverRenew TM6 Pump Station Capacity and Sizing (2023)
stormwater_pump_station_alexandria.quote: Waterfront Pump Station (PS1) rated at 198 cfs (130 mgd) and Thompsons Alley (PS2) at 132 cfs (85 mgd). Direct costs at baseline were $7,700,000 for PS1 and $8,200,000 for PS2.

stormwater_pump_station_west_pittston.unit: USD for 40,000 gpm (~89 cfs, 2.52 m3/s) storm pump station
stormwater_pump_station_west_pittston.source: West Pittston Borough, Appendix G Opinion of Costs (2019)
stormwater_pump_station_west_pittston.quote: Storm Pump Station (40,000 GPM) ... Pumping Station $1,900,000; project total $3,048,755

underground_cistern_storage.unit: USD per gallon installed, underground concrete cistern (range 2.50-6.00)
underground_cistern_storage.source: UGA Green Stormwater Infrastructure Demo Site, Stop 8 Cistern; welldrillingcosts.com Water Cisterns guide (2026)
underground_cistern_storage.quote: $1.50 to $7.00 per gallon of storage capacity (UGA). Concrete: $2.50-$6.00 per gallon installed (including excavation and backfill).
underground_cistern_storage.derivation: usd=midpoint of 2.50-6.00; per m3 = /0.0037854. Note: small residential/commercial cisterns; large municipal vaults typically lower per unit volume.

sandbag_bags_per_ft_usace.unit: bags per linear ft of pyramid dike
sandbag_bags_per_ft_usace.source: USACE Northwestern Division Sandbagging Techniques pamphlet (2004)
sandbag_bags_per_ft_usace.quote: Bags per 100 linear feet: 1 ft = 600; 2 ft = 2,100; 3 ft = 4,500; 4 ft = 7,800. A single width course 1 foot high requires 300 bags per 100 linear feet. N = (3H) + (9H^2)/2.

sandbag_wall_cost.unit: USD per linear ft, 3 ft high sandbag dike incl. materials, equipment, labour (before removal)
sandbag_wall_cost.metric_unit: USD per m length (0.91 m high)
sandbag_wall_cost.source: Aquapera Sandbag Cost Estimates (2019, vendor); Portadam Sandbag Cost Analysis (2023, vendor)
sandbag_wall_cost.quote: 164 ft x 3 ft (45 bags/ft): Sandbags $1575; Sand Fills $3360; Equipment Rentals $1800; Hand Tools $3616.2; Material Costs Subtotal $10,351.2; Labor $10,140; Response Subtotal $20,491.2. Portadam: It is widely accepted that sandbags cost $.25 each; 150 ft x 4 ft needs 11,700 sandbags, 455 man-hours.
sandbag_wall_cost.derivation: 20491.2/164 ft = $125/lf; per m = /0.3048 => $410/m; per 0.3 m height ~ /3 => ~$137/m (note bag count grows ~quadratically with height, so linear scaling overstates low walls)

sf_construction_cost_multiplier.unit: location factor vs US national average (RSMeans-style CCI/100)
sf_construction_cost_multiplier.source: constructionestimatinginfo.com Construction Cost Databases (RSMeans sample table); constructionbids.ai RSMeans guide (SF CCI 128.4)
sf_construction_cost_multiplier.quote: San Francisco, CA | 1.30 | 1.08 | 1.50 | 30% above national average (Total / Material / Labor); San Francisco (CCI: 128.4)
sf_construction_cost_multiplier.note: Secondary sources quoting RSMeans; official RSMeans 2024 change notices show SF weighted avg moved +1.03, -0.24, +1.90, +1.98 % per quarter in 2024 (https://www.rsmeans.com/media/wysiwyg/quarterly_updates/Q4-2024-ChangeNotice.pdf).

passive_flipup_flood_barrier.unit: USD per m2 of barrier face (passive/self-closing, installed)
passive_flipup_flood_barrier.metric_unit: USD per m2 barrier face (= USD per m length per m height)
passive_flipup_flood_barrier.source: A Better City - Passive Flood Barrier Overview and Product Comparisons (2015); City of Boston Flood Barriers page
passive_flipup_flood_barrier.quote: SAFB ... average $10,200 per square meter inclusive of installation costs. Aquafragma approximately $5,000 square meter plus installation. FloodBreak: 6' x 3' pedestrian gate $14,000; 25' x 3' vehicle gate $70,000. Boston: passive barriers $10,000 per square meter, useful life 50-100 years; modular interlocking panels $50-$100 per square foot.

deployable_flood_barrier.unit: USD per linear ft (AquaFence-type deployable, 2024 press range 350-1,000)
deployable_flood_barrier.source: floodbarrierpros.com Flood Barrier Cost (AquaFence press reports; Boxwall 2022 dealer list); St. Petersburg FL AquaFence purchase
deployable_flood_barrier.quote: $350-$1,000 per linear foot (2024); St. Petersburg, FL paid $1,150 per linear foot for a 9 ft tall, 500 ft long AquaFence; Boxwall $52.65/lf (BW-52) and $101.02/lf (BW-102); mobile aluminum barrier $361.15/lf.

catch_basin_inlet_ca.unit: USD each, curb opening catch basin (Windsor CA 2024)
catch_basin_inlet_ca.source: Town of Windsor Standard Unit Costs for Public Improvements 2024; Contra Costa County POL-44 Unit Price Guide (May 2024); County of San Diego 2025 Unit Price List
catch_basin_inlet_ca.quote: Curb Opening Catch Basin $6,695 each; Drop Inlet 18x18 $2,575 ... 48x48 $5,150 (Windsor). Contra Costa: Drainage Inlet Type D $4,200-8,400 EA. San Diego County: Catch Basin Type G $7,156.50 EA.

catch_basin_national_bidtabs.unit: USD each, catch basin or inlet (median of public bid tabs)
catch_basin_national_bidtabs.source: BuildGets - Public works unit prices from real bid tabs (787 bid tabs, 35 states, 2022-2026)
catch_basin_national_bidtabs.quote: Catch basin or inlet: EA, $7,500 median, $3,638-$13,000 middle 50%, 1,481 bids

wind_hail_homeowner_claim_avg.unit: USD average wind/hail homeowners claim (proxy for tree-on-house; Triple-I does not separate tree claims)
wind_hail_homeowner_claim_avg.source: Triple-I Facts + Statistics: Homeowners and renters insurance (2019-2023 avg $14,747 via clayem.com; 2018-2022 avg $13,511)
wind_hail_homeowner_claim_avg.quote: The average claim for wind and hail damage was $13,511 (2018-2022); 2019-2023 average wind and hail claim came to $14,747; about one in 35 insured homes has a wind/hail claim per year.

used_car_avg_listing_price.unit: USD average used-vehicle listing price (proxy for car total loss value)
used_car_avg_listing_price.source: Cox Automotive - Used-Vehicle Inventory Hits New 2025 High as December Begins; KBB Average Used Car Price Tops $27,000 (June 2026)
used_car_avg_listing_price.quote: The average used-vehicle listing price was $25,730 [start of Dec 2025] ... June [2026] $27,027, up 6% from a year ago.

wawona_stormwater_project.unit: USD total project (sewer pipes, water mains, stormwater tunnel; 25 city blocks)
wawona_stormwater_project.source: SFPUC - SFPUC Announces Completion of Wawona Area Stormwater Improvement Project
wawona_stormwater_project.quote: $29 million project that made major upgrades to San Francisco's combined sewer system across 25 city blocks in the West Portal and Parkside neighborhoods ... completed late 2023. Wawona, Folsom and Lower Alemany flood projects together $634 million (2022 approx. $622M).

sfpuc_flood_resilience_3_projects.unit: USD combined budget for Wawona, Folsom (FASIP) and Lower Alemany flood projects
sfpuc_flood_resilience_3_projects.source: SFPUC Wawona completion press release / SFPUC CAC minutes Jan 2022
sfpuc_flood_resilience_3_projects.quote: three flood projects (Wawona, Folsom, Lower Alemany), which together get $634 million

sf_lake_merced_green_street.source: SFPUC FY23 Wastewater Green Bond Report
sf_lake_merced_green_street.quote: Lake Merced: bioretention planters to manage runoff from 2.1 acres, removing 1 million gallons of stormwater in a typical year. SF has built or initiated 575 GI projects capturing >333 million gallons/yr.

green_street_bioretention_san_mateo.unit: USD per sq ft bioretention (planning-level green street, East Poplar Ave, San Mateo; $161,000 for 1.67 acre drainage area)
green_street_bioretention_san_mateo.source: C/CAG San Mateo County Green Street Project Concepts
green_street_bioretention_san_mateo.quote: East Poplar Avenue ... $161,000 for a 1.67-acre capture area, with bioretention priced at $25 per square foot.

tree_contract_prices_riverside_ca.unit: USD per tree, service-request prune (grid trim $94.45; removal+stump $45.55 per inch DBH; removal only $35.55/inch; plant 24in box $377.70; 36in box $1,194.20)
tree_contract_prices_riverside_ca.metric_unit: USD per tree; removal USD per cm DBH = 45.55/2.54 = 17.93
tree_contract_prices_riverside_ca.source: City of Riverside CA Public Works - Tree Care Program (FY 2024-25 contract rates)
tree_contract_prices_riverside_ca.quote: Grid Trim $94.45 each; Service Request Trim $219.95 each; Palm Trim $177.75; Tree and Stump Removal $45.55/inch; Tree Only Removal $35.55/inch; Stump Only Removal $21.10/inch; Root Pruning $24.45/foot; planting 15-gallon tree $205.55, 24" box $377.70, 36" box $1,194.20.

tree_removal_sf_private_market.unit: USD per tree removal, SF private market, 25-50 ft tree (under 25 ft $400-1,300; 50+ ft $2,000-8,000+)
tree_removal_sf_private_market.source: HandymanFix - Tree Service in San Francisco, CA: Costs & Tips (2026)
tree_removal_sf_private_market.quote: removal ~$400-1,300 for trees under 25 ft, ~$900-3,200 for 25-50 ft, and ~$2,000-8,000+ for 50+ ft
tree_removal_sf_private_market.derivation: usd = midpoint of 900-3200; low-quality secondary source

fema_p312_abandon_lower_level.unit: USD per sq ft footprint: abandon lower level (elevate/relocate utilities, add openings, flood-resistant materials) = wet-floodproofing-type retrofit
fema_p312_abandon_lower_level.source: FEMA P-312 Homeowner's Guide to Retrofitting, Chapter 3
fema_p312_abandon_lower_level.quote: this would involve primarily elevating or relocating utilities, adding openings in the lower-level walls, and ensuring that all construction materials are flood-resistant. The cost would be approximately $5 - $10 per square foot of building footprint.

storefront_glazing_bay_area.unit: USD per sq ft installed, aluminum storefront w/ tempered IGU (Bay Area); curtain wall $200-400/sf; glass-only tempered $12-30/sf
storefront_glazing_bay_area.source: Insight Glass - Commercial Storefront Windows Cost: 2026 Bay Area Pricing
storefront_glazing_bay_area.quote: standard thermally broken aluminum storefront with tempered IGU and basic Low-E runs $90 to $140 per square foot installed; Curtain Wall $200-$400 / sq ft installed. WindowServ: Fixed storefront window - tempered $12-$30/sq ft; IGU $20-$45/sq ft.

curtain_wall_glazing.unit: USD per sq ft installed curtain wall (Bay Area)
curtain_wall_glazing.source: Insight Glass - Commercial Storefront Windows Cost: 2026 Bay Area Pricing

wind_fence_fabric.unit: GBP per m2, knitted HDPE windbreak mesh fabric only (2m x 50m roll GBP 106.43-112.03); poles ~70% of installed cost
wind_fence_fabric.source: Suregreen Windbreak Fencing; WeatherSolve Porous Fabrics 101
wind_fence_fabric.quote: 2m x 50m roll GBP112.03 (GBP106.43 discounted); designed to reduce wind speeds by up to 50%. WeatherSolve: typically 70% of the total cost are the poles. Perforated metal windbreak panels US$12.00-17.00 / Square Meter (Made-in-China listing).
wind_fence_fabric.derivation: fabric per m2 = roll price/100 m2; installed estimate if fabric ~30% of cost => ~3.5-8.5 USD/m2 fabric fence (very rough, not sourced)

large_stormwater_tunnel_hcfcd.unit: USD per linear ft, 25-40 ft diameter stormwater conveyance tunnel (design+build)
large_stormwater_tunnel_hcfcd.source: Harris County Flood Control District - Z-08 Countywide Large Diameter Tunnels for Stormwater Conveyance
large_stormwater_tunnel_hcfcd.quote: For a single representative 10-mile tunnel section, the cost to design and build is estimated to be in the range of $3-$4 billion ... $300 million to $400 million per mile, or $57,000 to $76,000 per linear foot.
large_stormwater_tunnel_hcfcd.note: Much larger diameter than FASIP 12 ft; scale down for SF.

underground_detention_per_cf.unit: USD per cubic ft of storage, underground detention
underground_detention_per_cf.source: stormwaterdrainage.com - Stormwater Detention Systems: Types, Sizing & Cost
underground_detention_per_cf.quote: Underground detention typically runs $8.50-$17.00 per cubic foot of storage.

earthworks_roadway_excavation_ca.unit: USD per cubic yard roadway excavation (Windsor CA 2024)
earthworks_roadway_excavation_ca.source: Town of Windsor Standard Unit Costs for Public Improvements 2024; Contra Costa County POL-44 Unit Price Guide (May 2024)
earthworks_roadway_excavation_ca.quote: Roadway Excavation C.Y. $97.85; Cold Plane Asphalt Concrete Pavement S.Y. $25.75 (Windsor). Contra Costa: Roadway excavation 0-1,000 CY: 110-290; 1,000 CY or more: 50-140 per CY. Asphalt concrete (Type A, 150 lbs/CF) 0-1,000 TONS: 155-330/TON; >1,000 TONS: 110-175/TON.

repaving_asphalt.unit: USD per ton HMA Type A (Contra Costa, <1,000 t: 155-330); cold plane $25.75/SY
repaving_asphalt.metric_unit: USD per m2 for 100 mm AC overlay (derived)
repaving_asphalt.source: Contra Costa County POL-44 Unit Price Guide (May 2024); Town of Windsor 2024
repaving_asphalt.quote: Asphalt concrete: (Type A, assume 150 lbs/CF) 0-1,000 TONS: 155-330 TON
repaving_asphalt.derivation: midpoint $242.5/short ton = $267/tonne; 100 mm AC at 2.35 t/m3 = 0.235 t/m2 => ~$63/m2 paving; plus cold plane $25.75/SY = $30.8/m2 => ~$94/m2 mill+pave (derived)

earthworks_combined_street_regrade.metric_unit: USD per m3 regraded, incl. repaving, assuming 0.3 m average cut/fill depth (derived)
earthworks_combined_street_regrade.derivation: excavation $128/m3 (Windsor $97.85/CY) + mill/pave ~$94/m2 spread over 0.3 m depth (~$313/m3); multiply by SF factor ~1.3. Not a sourced number.
earthworks_combined_street_regrade.source: derived from Windsor 2024 and Contra Costa 2024 unit costs

floodwall_nyc_escr_allin.unit: USD per linear ft, all-in urban coastal resiliency project (floodwalls, raised park, 18 gates, sewer upgrades) ESCR $1.45B / 2.4 mi
floodwall_nyc_escr_allin.metric_unit: USD per m length (all-in, not wall alone)
floodwall_nyc_escr_allin.source: NYC Mayor's Office - Mayor Adams Completes First Section of East Side Coastal Resiliency Project (Oct 2024); Yale E360
floodwall_nyc_escr_allin.quote: ESCR is a $1.45 billion project which is creating a flexible, 2.4-mile-long flood barrier on the Lower East Side ... raised parkland, floodwalls, berms, and 18 swinging or sliding flood gates. Brooklyn Bridge-Montgomery: $350 million, one mile.

tree_on_property_claim_avg.unit: USD average insurance claim involving trees (unspecified home/auto)
tree_on_property_claim_avg.source: National General - Storm Recovery: Impacts of Tree Falling on My Home or Car
tree_on_property_claim_avg.quote: the average insurance claim involving trees is over $4,000
tree_on_property_claim_avg.note: Weak source (no year/method). Car repair examples in AAA/Policygenius explainers: $2,500-$4,000; use as car tree-strike body damage proxy.

fema_standard_economic_values.unit: USD per person per day of lost service (value of lost time USD/hour)
fema_standard_economic_values.source: FEMA Benefit-Cost Analysis Sustainment and Enhancements: Standard Economic Values Methodology Report (Sept 2022)
fema_standard_economic_values.quote: Value of Lost Time $34.72 -> $38.07; Loss of Electric Services $174 -> $182; Wastewater $58 -> $60; Potable Water $114 -> $116; Communications/IT -> $130

sf_county_gdp.unit: USD nominal GDP, San Francisco County (2023: $258.8B) - business interruption proxy
sf_county_gdp.source: FRED GDPALL06075 Gross Domestic Product: All Industries in San Francisco County, CA (BEA)

streettreesf_maintenance_budget.unit: USD/yr StreetTreeSF fund for ~124,000 street trees (maintenance + tree-related sidewalk repair)
streettreesf_maintenance_budget.source: SF Public Works - StreetTreeSF Annual Report FY2018/2019
streettreesf_maintenance_budget.quote: $19 million annually to fund tree maintenance and tree-related sidewalk repairs ... FY2018/19 fund $19.7 million covering 124,000-plus street trees; pruned 11,615 street trees (7,894 by contractors, 3,721 in-house); pruning on a three- to five-year cycle

sf_urban_forest_plan_owner_cost.unit: USD per tree per year owner cost (maintenance, sidewalk repair, sidewalk-fall claims)
sf_urban_forest_plan_owner_cost.source: SF Planning - Financing San Francisco's Urban Forest: Benefits + Costs of a Comprehensive Program (Urban Forest Plan Financing Study, Exec Summary 2013)
sf_urban_forest_plan_owner_cost.quote: Property owners estimated at $160-$175 per year per tree for maintenance, sidewalk repair and sidewalk-fall claims; FY11-12 on a 15-year pruning cycle; proposed average five-year pruning cycle.

floodwall_lsu_residential_4ft.unit: USD per linear ft permanent residential floodwall (plus labor); 1998: 4-ft floodwall ~$120/lf
floodwall_lsu_residential_4ft.metric_unit: USD per m length (~1.2 m high)
floodwall_lsu_residential_4ft.source: LSU AgCenter - Flood Barrier and Protection; LSU AgCenter Pub 2745 floodwall
floodwall_lsu_residential_4ft.quote: Floodwalls average $150 per linear foot plus labor to install. The typical cost of a basic 4-foot floodwall was about $120 per linear foot in 1998.

flood_shield_door_barrier.unit: USD per opening, sliding/swinging flood door or shield
flood_shield_door_barrier.source: City of Boston - Flood Barriers (Office of Emergency Management)

FASIP: tunnel ~4,000 ft (1,219 m; CEQA says 3,800 ft) x 12 ft (3.66 m) ID, Alameda/De Haro/Berry St to 7th & Berry. No public tunnel construction cost or capacity (m3/s or MG) found in time; only Phase 2 CWSRF loan NTE $59M and the 3-project (Wawona+Folsom+Lower Alemany) $634M envelope. HCFCD $57-76k/lf is for 25-40 ft diameter tunnels; for a 12 ft tunnel scale down (not sourced).
Discount rate: FEMA used OMB A-94 3.1% from Apr 2024 until OMB revoked it 8 Apr 2025; 7% applies to projects not awarded before then. Use 7% base with 3.1% sensitivity.

SF location factor ~1.30 (secondary RSMeans quotes 1.284-1.35). National/other-state figures (EPA, USACE Midwest, Alexandria pump stations) should be multiplied by ~1.3 and escalated to 2025 dollars (not done in this file).
